title: fg test scenario
description: A test account state that `fg seed <scenario>` creates and `fg teardown <run>` removes. Format and every shipped scenario: docs/TEST_FIXTURES.md.

summary.description: One sentence: what state this is.

views.description: Per-user client view that `fg sync` applies after sign-in (the app keeps it on the device, not the server).

relTime.description: Relative to seeding time: now, -90m, -2h, -3d, or a past day at a Berlin wall-clock time like "-3d 18:10" (days >= 1, so it is always in the past).

handle.description: Short id used in scenarios and on the CLI (--as <run>:<handle>). peter and lea are reserved for the baseline seed.

locale.description: Stored in user_metadata.locale and used as the browser locale by fg sync.

stores.description: The household's stores, in the store picker's order. A household starts with none; items, trips and views may name only these.

history.description: Past shopping trips: items added, then ticked off together.

add.description: New categories, created like the app does (before Sonstiges).

order.description: Route order: these first, in this order; the rest keep theirs.

name.description: Created as the app adds a store (add_store). Fixtures use generic names (Supermarkt, Drogerie, Bäckerei, Wochenmarkt); dm, Lidl or Edeka would become that chain, with its layout and brand defaults.

layout.description: Walk order: these categories first, in this order; the rest keep the route order.

hidden.description: Categories this store does not carry.

store.description: A store of this household; default: none (any supermarket), or what item→store memory says.

category.description: A category of this household; default: the server classifier.

by.description: Who added it; default: the first member (on a trip: whoever shopped).

at.description: When it was added; default: just now, in list order (on a trip: 1 day before it).

brand.description: items.brand (job 15). Seeding fails with needs_column on a database without it.

walkOrder.description: Per-item position within store and category (job 15's sort_key). Same rule as brand.

at.description: When the items were ticked off (the newest trip when repeated).

by.description: Who ticked them off; default: the first member.

store.description: Ticked off in this store's view: tags the items and teaches item→store memory.

every.description: Repeat the trip at this interval, going back in time.

times.description: How many trips in total (with every).

by.description: Member who creates it; default: the owner.

expires.description: Override expiry, e.g. +2d or -1d (expired); default: 7 days (single use since job 22).

store.description: The store this member shops at: every other store section but "Ohne Laden" is folded (design H has no store view).

expect.description: Checked after seeding, as a member through RLS. Counts are always checked too.

usuals.description: Per household handle: names suggest_items must return.

due.description: Per household handle: names suggest_items must mark due.

notDue.description: Per household handle: names suggest_items returns but not as due.
